Ravi (AE): Enterprise prospect (Orchid Bank) insisted on 14-day purge for request logs + proof for DSARs. Also asked if SCCs cover transfers. Need SIG-ready wording and a DPA clause. @Mira @Julian

Mira (Security): Hosted default is 180d. We can support contract-configurable processed-index TTL down to 14d if we enable ingestion masking. Note: raw cold backups and immutable snapshots may be longer unless Dedicated.

Julian (Privacy): From privacy side: we can commit to deleting or irreversibly pseudonymizing customer-identifiable data from searchable indices within 14 days and provide a deletion certificate. Must call out exceptions (legal hold, backups) in the DPA.

Ravi (AE): Orchid wants SCC confirmation and a list of subprocessors in the SIG/CAIQ answers.

Mira (Security): For SIG: answer "Data retention" as: configurable per contract; default 180d; option for 14d on processed indices with ingestion PII-stripping; backups handled per backup policy or Dedicated deployment.

InfraBot: Ticket INF-1310 created: "ingestion-pii-strip" owner=eng-logging ETA=2w. INF-1311: "dsar-deletion-sweep" owner=infra-search ETA=3w.

LegalBot: Draft DPA clause attached. Key lines: retention configurable; deletion/pseudonymization within SLA; deletion certificate; subprocessor appendix; SCCs referenced.

Julian (Privacy): Suggest adding certificate contents: deletion timestamp, systems searched, and a non-reversible hash of deleted identifiers.

Mira (Security): Ops note for SIG: avoid promises about immediate wipe of immutable backups in hosted. Recommend two options to customer: (A) Hosted w/ 14d processed-index deletion + ingestion masking + deletion cert (modest surcharge), (B) Dedicated/Private for contractual raw-log purge (higher cost).

Ravi (AE): I'll send Orchid the two-option proposal, SIG-friendly answers, and the DPA draft. Action items: Mira confirm INF ticket timelines; Julian finalize cert wording; Legal finalize clause and SCCs note.

LegalBot: Acknowledged. Will prep final SIG/CAIQ entries and DPA appendix after Julian's edit.

Ravi (AE): Thanks team — will update after Orchid review. :thumbsup:
